change: Fix: directional hybrid staging no longer overlaps remotely written inboxes. With two or more FFN domains the Attention stages dispatch at window offset 0; with two or more Attention domains the FFN stages combine replies in a slice reserved at the window end.

bug.introduced: section 7 (directional hybrid protocol, 6f16106) dropped the cross-domain entry barriers, which had also ordered staging reuse
bug.attention_side: Attention dispatch staging (offset L*D*max*Td) overlapped its combine scale-out inbox region 0 (offset L*D*max*Tc); FFN domain 0 can write combine-N replies there while the NIC still reads staging for FFN domain 1
bug.ffn_side: FFN combine staging overlapped its dispatch scale-out inbox regions; Attention domain 1 can write dispatch N+1 there after its own combine-N signals while the NIC still reads staging for Attention domain 2
bug.affected_layouts: directional hybrid with two or more FFN domains (Attention side) or two or more Attention domains (FFN side); one FFN and one Attention domain are safe because every reply or next request follows the per-channel signals sent after that channel's puts on the same QP

fault_injection.method: scratch kernels defer the puts (and finish tail / signal) to the last destination domain until the end of the channel, behind a globaltimer spin: 3 ms for the Attention dispatch to the last FFN domain, 300 us for the FFN combine to the last Attention domain; patches below

before_fix.ffn_side_2_attention_domains: fails: replies at the second Attention domain mismatch 257,531 of 4,194,304 elements (6.1%), greatest absolute difference 4.5
before_fix.attention_side_2_ffn_domains_3ms: fails: the second FFN domain hits an illegal memory access from corrupted tokens and the Attention times out waiting for its replies
before_fix.attention_side_2_ffn_domains_300us: passes (FFN domain 0 had not yet replied)
before_fix.without_injection: both layouts pass (the race is timing-dependent)
